title: Electrochemical and hot corrosion behaviour of annealed AlCoCrFeNi HEA coating over steel.

recollection.starting_material: Guess: Steel with AlCoCrFeNi High-Entropy Alloy (HEA) coating
recollection.structure: Guess: Modified microstructure of the HEA coating
recollection.mechanism: Guess: Improved corrosion resistance due to altered microstructure and composition
recollection.results: Guess: Enhanced electrochemical and hot corrosion behavior of the annealed HEA coating compared to the as-deposited coating

score.note: The recollection only generically identifies annealing of an AlCoCrFeNi coating and broadly attributes improved corrosion resistance to microstructural/compositional changes. It omits the plasma-spray deposition, annealing temperatures and duration, specific BCC/FCC and grain-refinement features, passive-oxide mechanism, and all quantitative hardness and corrosion results.
